interface_to_donor.donor_power_dependency: Do not draw field power from undocumented donor rails.

required_functions.requirement: sidecar supply and field-power telemetry where implemented

candidate_architecture.usb_controller: USB-capable MCU with deterministic open toolchain support; exact part not frozen yet
candidate_architecture.can: 1 isolated or appropriately protected CAN transceiver channel
candidate_architecture.digital_io: protected 24V-tolerant or explicitly lower-voltage bounded interface; final voltage class must be frozen before schematic
candidate_architecture.host_power: USB powers logic only unless a later verified budget says otherwise
candidate_architecture.field_power: external low-voltage input if required; separately protected/fused/current-limited

unresolved_before_schematic: freeze USB-C receptacle/ESD and 3.3 V regulator
validate isolated-domain current budget against the selected 2 W converter
freeze ISO1410/ISO1042 package variants and field protection
freeze ISO1212 threshold network for 18-30 V input window
freeze TPS4H160 current-limit and field-supply protection
freeze connector family and testpoint map
gate_rule: BenchIO standalone schematic work is independent of donor internals because the only donor interface is standard external USB. A real POS462/B91 acceptance record is still mandatory before BenchHMI system-integration claims, finished-unit proof, or sale.
